## Governance checklist
- [ ] I identified the affected data/system domain and owner.
- [ ] I described user/data impact and rollback.
- [ ] If schema/RLS changed, I added a migration and database regression test.
- [ ] If a metric or decision rule changed, I updated `docs/METRICS_GLOSSARY.md` and/or version metadata.
- [ ] If an external source changed, I updated `docs/DATA_CATALOG.md` and source metadata.
- [ ] If architecture or operations changed, I updated the canonical documentation or explained why not.
- [ ] I did not silently rewrite historical data semantics.
